CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_authz.evidence(actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(role text, revision bigint, now_s numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_user<>'mxas_resolver' OR actor_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM current_setting('mixer_atomic.actor',true) OR NOT mixer_authz.allowed('o','p') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'policy denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT f.role,f.revision,c.now_s FROM mixer_authz.fixture_policy f CROSS JOIN mixer_authz.fixture_clock c WHERE f.actor=actor_id AND c.id=1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'missing policy';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.a(parts bytea[])
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE h bytea; result bytea;part bytea;
BEGIN h:=mixer_hosted_release.u(cardinality(parts));result:=set_byte(h,0,get_byte(h,0)+128);FOREACH part IN ARRAY parts LOOP IF part IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'implicit null';END IF;result:=result||part;END LOOP;RETURN result;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.b(v bytea)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE h bytea;
BEGIN IF v IS NULL THEN RETURN decode('f6','hex');END IF;h:=mixer_hosted_release.u(octet_length(v));RETURN set_byte(h,0,get_byte(h,0)+64)||v;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.changed_state(previous bytea, i mixer_hosted_release.upload_input)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT mixer_hosted_release.hash_domain('mixer.hosted.state.v1',mixer_hosted_release.a(ARRAY[mixer_hosted_release.u(1),mixer_hosted_release.b(previous),mixer_hosted_release.a(ARRAY[mixer_hosted_release.a(ARRAY[mixer_hosted_release.u(1),mixer_hosted_release.b(i.manifest),mixer_hosted_release.b(i.payload_hash),mixer_hosted_release.u(i.payload_size),mixer_hosted_release.t(i.blob_ref),mixer_hosted_release.target(i),mixer_hosted_release.b(sha256(i.signed_document)),mixer_hosted_release.b(i.signature)])])])) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.finite_uint(v numeric, lo numeric, hi numeric)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(v>=lo AND v<=hi AND trunc(v)=v,false) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.hash_domain(domain_name text, encoded bytea)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT sha256(convert_to(domain_name,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||encoded) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.hx(v text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE b bytea; BEGIN IF v IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;b:=decode(v,'hex');IF encode(b,'hex')<>v THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'hex';END IF;RETURN b;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.jarray(v jsonb, n integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN IF jsonb_typeof(v) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(v)<>n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display array';END IF;RETURN v;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.jhex(v jsonb, lo integer, hi integer)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s text;b bytea;BEGIN s:=mixer_hosted_release.jtext(v,lo*2,hi*2);IF s!~'^[0-9a-f]*$' OR length(s)%2<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display hex';END IF;b:=decode(s,'hex');IF octet_length(b) NOT BETWEEN lo AND hi THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display hex bound';END IF;RETURN b;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.jid(v jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s text;BEGIN s:=mixer_hosted_release.jtext(v,1,128);IF s!~'^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display id';END IF;RETURN s;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.jip(v jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s text;BEGIN IF v='null'::jsonb THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;s:=mixer_hosted_release.jtext(v,1,45);IF host(s::inet)<>s THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display ip';END IF;RETURN s;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.jtext(v jsonb, lo integer, hi integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s text; BEGIN IF jsonb_typeof(v) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display text type';END IF;s:=v#>>'{}';IF octet_length(s) NOT BETWEEN lo AND hi THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display text bound';END IF;RETURN s;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.juint(v jsonb, lo numeric, hi numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s text;BEGIN s:=mixer_hosted_release.jtext(v,1,20);IF s!~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$' OR NOT mixer_hosted_release.finite_uint(s::numeric,lo,hi) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display integer';END IF;RETURN s::numeric;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.juuid(v jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s text;BEGIN s:=mixer_hosted_release.jtext(v,36,36);IF s!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' OR (s::uuid)::text<>s THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'display uuid';END IF;RETURN uuid_send(s::uuid);END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.t(v text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE vbytes bytea;h bytea;
BEGIN IF v IS NULL THEN RETURN decode('f6','hex');END IF;vbytes:=convert_to(v,'UTF8');h:=mixer_hosted_release.u(octet_length(vbytes));RETURN set_byte(h,0,get_byte(h,0)+96)||vbytes;END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.target(i mixer_hosted_release.upload_input)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT mixer_hosted_release.a(ARRAY[mixer_hosted_release.t(i.organization),mixer_hosted_release.t(i.project),mixer_hosted_release.t(i.app),mixer_hosted_release.t(i.environment),mixer_hosted_release.t(i.platform),mixer_hosted_release.b(i.runtime),mixer_hosted_release.b(i.manifest)]) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_hosted_release.time_valid(c mixer_hosted_release.call_context, now_s numeric, wall_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN IF NOT mixer_hosted_release.finite_uint(now_s,0,9007199254740991) OR c.authentication_completed_at>=c.expires_at OR now_s>=c.expires_at OR c.authentication_completed_at<now_s-45 OR c.authentication_completed_at>now_s+30 OR c.deadline IS NULL OR c.deadline<=wall_now THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'expired' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;RETURN true;END $function$
